name: DOCEtaxel plus Prednisone (mCRPC)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic taxane chemotherapy is not biomarker-restricted. Castrate testosterone (below 50 ng/dL) must be maintained with ongoing ADT. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer, Systemic Therapy for M1 CRPC (PROS-18) and Discussion.

premedications.name: Corticosteroid premedication for docetaxel (fluid retention / hypersensitivity)
premedications.notes: Give per docetaxel labeling (dexamethasone premedication); specific premedication schedule not enumerated in the provided prostate extract.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Provide per emetogenic-risk tier on the day of chemotherapy.

supportiveCare: continue ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL (PROS-G).

cycles null: source-stated standard is every 3 weeks; the total number of cycles is not fixed in the provided extract (TAX327 gave up to 10 cycles) and is individualized; treat to response/tolerance under clinical review.
companion prednisone 5 mg PO twice daily throughout.
G-CSF: assess febrile-neutropenia risk per taxane chemotherapy standards.
monitor for peripheral neuropathy, fluid retention, and hypersensitivity (docetaxel).
monitoring: peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle
PSA and serum testosterone (confirm castrate level)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 neutropenia or febrile neutropenia
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and dose-reduce docetaxel per labeling; consider G-CSF prophylaxis; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion, prostate line 7419 (the standard regimen is 75 mg/m2 every 3 weeks). ISMP tall-man DOCEtaxel. 75 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle (TAX327). A biweekly alternative of 50 mg/m2 is source-stated (prostate line 7420) but not modeled here.

provenance.locator: Discussion, prostate line 7419 (the standard regimen is 75 mg/m2 every 3 weeks; a biweekly 50 mg/m2 alternative exists)

drugs.name: Prednisone
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion, prostate line 7266 (prednisone 5 mg twice daily). Companion daily prednisone 5 mg PO twice daily continuously with docetaxel (TAX327). Represented as days 1 to 21 of the 21-day cycle (continuous).

provenance.locator: Discussion, prostate line 7266 (prednisone 5 mg twice daily companion steroid)
